title: Glitch
summary: A few frames of torn bands and RGB split, then B.
signature: glitch(a, b, p, { seed, steps, rgb, shift })

params.name: seed
params.description: random seed; change it for a different variation

notes: A few frames of torn bands, jitter and RGB split; the bands show more of B until B holds.
At p = 0 only A shows, at p = 1 only B; keep B above A (z-index).
Only for a digital or raw identity.
when: the identity is digital, broken, underground
